title: Mirror pairs on a circle with a non-decimal radius still give two outcomes: binary pairs give the pencil, decimal pairs give the line
detail: The new decimal pencil rule runs only when C's centre and radius are 12-digit decimals. A 3-point circle (or any circle whose radius is irrational) falls through. A binary-exact mirror pair is caught by the exact test and gives the pencil. A decimal mirror pair goes to the centre-collinear rule and gives the line through the centre. This is the same one-configuration, two-outcomes problem as math-3. It is now limited to circles that are not stored as decimals. Free circles with decimal c and r, lines, and the real axis all behave correctly.
evidence: App, dist/test.html, notes/orthogonal-circle/verify/d.js and a_body.js. C = circle through 0, 1, i (c = 0.5+0.5i, r = 0.70710678…). P = 1+0.5i, Q = 1.5+0.5i: undef 'pencil'. P = 0.6+0.5i, Q = 5.5+0.5i: kind 'line'. The other 5 decimal mirror pairs on that circle also give 'line'. A free circle c = 0.5+0.5i, r = Math.SQRT1_2 gives 'line' for both pairs.
fix: Pick one outcome for all mirror pairs. Either test the mirror condition on C's exact form, so that A f(P) f(Q) matches the pencil in exact arithmetic on P, Q and the form coefficients (circle3's form is exact rational from decimal points), or let the exact binary test also return the centre line. Add the circle3 pair to section E.

title: fix163_cmd hangs at U12 in a fresh harness, so U12 and U4 never report
detail: U12 sends Input.dispatchTouchEvent while touch emulation is off (view(1440, 900, false, false)). On my daemon (port 9827) the command never returned. The server log ends at test.html?ns=…u12, and there was no .out after more than 10 minutes. The ledger's 20/20 cannot be reproduced as written. This is a test problem, not an app bug. The app behaviour U12 and U4 check holds when tested separately: the phone tap gives the touch chip 'Pick a line or a circle · Touching' with no 'Esc cancels', and the T glider drag has frame p95 16.7 ms.
evidence: work/xv163/test/fix163_cmd.js with the port changed to 9827 (scratchpad copy). The daemon had to be killed. Separate checks are in notes/orthogonal-circle/verify/c.js.
fix: In U12, turn on touch emulation before the tap (send Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled {enabled: true, maxTouchPoints: 5}) and turn it off afterwards, or call view(1440, 900, false, true). Also take the port from one constant.

title: The ledger says the wide-pane chip keeps 'Perpendicular circle'; the app's chip says 'Orthogonal'
detail: At 1440 × 900 the chip reads 'Pick a line or a circle · Orthogonal · Esc cancels', and the tooltip reads 'Perpendicular circle'. That is fine for users. Only the ledger's claim is wrong. The chip's DOM also contains a hidden polygon hint, which is not visible.
evidence: notes/orthogonal-circle/verify/b_body.js and d.js: the visible chip leaf is 'Pick a line or a circle · Orthogonal · Esc cancels'.
fix: Correct the ledger line, or build the chip from the tooltip name if 'Perpendicular circle' was intended.
